name: HP Student Store
summary: Student pricing, cashback and bundle deals on HP laptops when you sign in with a uni email.
need: A school email address, such as one ending in .edu.au.
how: Sign in or create an account on the HP Student Store with your uni email.
catches: HP doesn't publish a fixed discount. Compare with the regular store.
Orders are sold and shipped by Ingram Micro, with 14-day change-of-mind returns.
